title: cynarospermum asperrimum
intro: Cynarospermum asperrimum, commonly known as Khasra or Khas, is a plant species in the family Apiaceae. It is used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, with its health benefits including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Cynarospermum asperrimum include reducing inflammation, fighting off infections, and protecting against oxidative stress.
